file.description: Vendor credit / credit memo file (required, max 20 MB). Accepts PDF and image scans: pdf, jpg, jpeg, png, tif, tiff, bmp, webp.

supplier_id.description: Optional. Supplier ID to pre-assign to the extraction.

purchase_order_id.description: Optional. Pre-link the scan to a purchase order (e.g. when launched from a PO page). The PO's supplier is used as the supplier hint when supplier_id is omitted, and the pre-linked PO takes precedence over OCR's own PO-number match.
